# #central-team, Jun 9
6/9/26

Hollis Mbeki  10:42 AM  
Marrow Agrisupply escalated this morning. New stores are rolling out too slowly; store ops says they're still booking inbound trucks in the spreadsheet while waiting for Pemberline Dock setup. We need a store-by-store answer for the Central team's ag account today.

Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram  10:44 AM  
Saw it. Marrow Agri sent a screenshot of the rollout tracker, not the actual blocker list. Three rows just say “waiting.” I'll call store ops and get names, shift times, and what each store is waiting on.

Hollis Mbeki  10:46 AM  
I'll take setup/support. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached, but the file labels doors as E1/E2 and their booking sheet uses 01/02. Need that sorted before anyone reimports and creates duplicates.

Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram  10:48 AM  
Also Pine Crossing. Morning receiver says the appointment screen shows the afternoon shift only. Driver arrived at 7:10 yesterday and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Not a training complaint if the shift isn't there.

Hollis Mbeki  10:50 AM  
Yep. I'll check the shift template and ask support to reproduce with the store login. No blanket “ready” status until somebody opens the calendar and makes a test booking.

Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram  10:53 AM  
I'll get one receiving lead per store on a short call. Need them at a workstation, not walking the yard. Will ask for a screenshot of the missing shift and the exact door they're trying to book.

Hollis Mbeki  10:55 AM  
Send me the list by noon pls. I'll put blockers and next action into the tracker. Leave the old target column alone; add a separate next-check column so we don't lose what they were expecting.

Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram  10:57 AM  
On it. I'll send store ops one reply this afternoon with the split: setup fixes from you, store follow-ups from me. Also asking them to stop forwarding the same screenshot in seperate threads.

Hollis Mbeki  10:59 AM  
Good. Ping here if another store is stuck. I'll post the ticket updates before lunch.
